summary: Khenchen Thrangu Rinpoche (1933–2023) worked in Buddhist studies and Tibetology, studying under Rangjung Rigpe Dorje and Khenpo Gangshar. He served as abbot of Rumtek Monastery (~1968), Karma Shri Nalanda Institute (~1981), and Gampo Abbey (~1984–2023).
Khenchen Tsewang Rigdzin studied under Shenphen Nangwa, Khenpo Ngawang Pelzang, Thubten Chökyi Dorje, and Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo.

Khenpo Appey (1927–2010) was a scholar in Tibetology and Buddhist studies who studied at Dzongsar Shedra under Khenpo Dragyab Lodrö. He served as director of Sakya College (1972–1985) and held a post at the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology.
Khenpo Dazer, a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology, studied under Botrul Dongak Tenpai Nyima. He served as a teacher at both Dzogchen Monastery and Ngagyur Nyingma Institute.

Khenpo Gangshar (1925–1980) worked in Buddhist studies and Tibetology, studying at Shechen Monastery under Shechen Kongtrul Pema Drime Lekpe Lodro. He served as senior teacher at Shechen Monastery and founding dean at Surmang Monastery (~1957–1958).

Khenpo Karthar Rinpoche (1924–2019) worked in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied at Thrangu Monastery and under Khenpo Gangshar and the 8th Traleg Rinpoche, later teaching at Rumtek Monastery (1967) and serving as abbot of Karma Triyana Dharmachakra (1978).
Khenpo Konchok Gyaltsen (born 1946) works in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied under Khunu Lama Tenzin Gyaltsen, Khyunga Rinpoche, and Pachung Rinpoche.
Khenpo Lodrö Dönyö works in the fields of Buddhist studies and Tibetology, having studied under Kalu Rinpoche and Bokar Rinpoche.

Khenpo Ngawang Pelzang (1879–1941) worked in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied under numerous teachers, including Shenphen Nangwa, Kunzang Pelden, Mipam Gyatso, Thubten Chökyi Dorje, and Lungtok Tenpé Nyima (~1898–1901).
Khenpo Sherab Püntsok studied under Ogyen Trinley Dorje and Khenchen Thrangu Rinpoche.

Khenpo Tsultrim Gyamtso Rinpoche (1934–2024) worked in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and philosophy. He studied under Lama Zopa Tarchin and Rangjung Rigpe Dorje, later serving as principal teacher at Rumtek Monastery's shedra and spiritual advisor at Pullahari Monastery (1992).

Khetsun Sangpo Rinpoche (1920–2009) worked in Buddhist studies and Tibetology, studying under Dudjom Rinpoche and Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche. He taught at the University of Tokyo and Kyoto University (1960–1970) and at the University of Virginia.

Khunu Lama Tenzin Gyaltsen (1895–1977) worked in Buddhist studies, Indology, and Tibetology, studying under Shenphen Nangwa and Khenpo Ngawang Pelzang. He held teaching posts at Men-Tsee-Khang and Sampurnanand Sanskrit University.

Khunu Rinpoche (1894–1977) was a scholar in Tibetology and Buddhist studies who studied at Rumtek Monastery and under Rasvir Das, Sönam Gyaltsen, and Dev Narayan Tripathi. He held a teaching post at Men-Tsee-Khang.
Khyenrab Norbu (1882–1962) worked in Tibetology, having studied under Tré Khang Jampa Tubwang, Tsipa Ngawo Ché, Drung Yik Rabten, and Tso Jé Dorjé Gyaltsen.

id: P:Khyungpo Gyal Tön Rinpoche Karma Orgyen Jikme Chökyi Sengé
summary: Khyungpo Gyal Tön Rinpoche Karma Orgyen Jikme Chökyi Sengé studied under Pema Wangchok Gyelpo, Khenpo Ngawang Pelzang, and Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö.
Ki-yong Rhi (1922–1996) worked in Buddhist studies and philosophy, holding a post at Dongguk University (attested 1983) and later serving as professor emeritus there (attested 2007).

Kiattisak Ponampon works in Buddhist studies. He earned an MA at the University of Otago under Xiaohuan Zhao, Will Sweetman, and Elizabeth Guthrie (attested 2015), and studied with Jinhua Chen and Seishi Karashima in 2013.

Kichinosuke Ito (1885–1961) was a philosophy scholar educated at the University of Tokyo and University of Freiburg. He served as professor at the University of Tokyo (1923–1945), dean at Hokkaido University (1947; 1950–1951), and professor at Chuo University (1951–1958).
Kim Gutschow works in Tibetology and Buddhist studies, earned a PhD at Harvard University, and served as a teacher at Wesleyan University.
